snippets.description: Triggers, permissions, concurrency: no pull_request, contents: write only, own group
snippets.content:
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 22 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: chain-growth-snapshot
  cancel-in-progress: false

snippets.description: Commit scope limited to onchain archive; commit only on non-empty diff; 3-attempt rebase retry
snippets.content:
git add api/data/cache/onchain/
if git diff --staged --quiet; then exit 0; fi
...for attempt in 1 2 3; do git pull --rebase origin "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" && git push && exit 0; ...

snippets.description: merge_onchain_series: insert new, revise in 14-day window with previous_value, freeze older (count drift), never delete, rewrite only on change
snippets.content: def merge_onchain_series(source, chain_id, metric, points, *, today, now_utc, window_days=14) -> OnchainMergeResult
